title: Analysis: DeepSeek's hedge fund parent High-Flyer posted 56.6% average returns across its quant funds in 2025, boosting potential cash available for DeepSeek (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Analysis: DeepSeek's hedge fund parent High-Flyer posted 56.6% average returns across its quant funds in 2025, boosting potential cash available for DeepSeek — DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng's quantitative hedge fund generated returns of more than 50% last year, boosting the potential war chest …
